title: Share of studied residents living in the highest urban-heat-island exposure (8 degrees F or more of added heat)

source.name: Urban Heat Hot Spots in 65 Cities

notes: Of the 50 million residents across the 65 cities Climate Central analyzed in 2024, nearly 34 million (68%) live in census block groups with a UHI index of 8 degrees F or higher; the remainder (32%) live in less-exposed blocks within the same cities.
